# activedirectory_group (Data Source)

Look up a group by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Errors if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single group by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Exactly one
# identity attribute must be set; the lookup errors if the group is absent.
data "activedirectory_group" "admins" {
  sam_account_name = "Domain Admins"
}

output "admins_dn" {
  value = data.activedirectory_group.admins.dn
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dn` (String) Look the object up by distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) Look the object up by objectGUID.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Look the object up by sAMAccountName.
- `sid` (String) Look the object up by security identifier.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) security or distribution.
- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `managed_by` (String) DN of the managing principal.
- `name` (String) The group's name (RDN).
- `scope` (String) global, domainlocal, or universal.
